Raw value is a CIP code (e.g. 11.0101), matched against Program Master's 'CIP Code' column (col 9) to get the Program Name (col 5) -- NOT the default code_col/name_col for this sheet (those are for the CAA Program Code field instead), which is why code_col/name_col are overridden here explicitly. Any code ending in '.9999' (CIP's generic 'Other/catch-all' sub-code within any family -- 99.9999 is the spec's own sentinel for 'undeclared major', but 15.9999/52.9999/etc. are the same idea for other families) has no single specific program in Program Master by design, so it's forced blank via value_override_suffixes instead of being flagged as a lookup failure. CAVEAT: for a real (non-.9999) CIP code, Program Master can list more than one program under the same CIP classification (seen for this same institution: MBA and BBA both = 52.0201) -- when that happens this lookup picks whichever matching row comes last in Program Master, which is NOT guaranteed to be the applicant's actual program. Spot-check Student_program on the Final sheet against App_Student_Major for any CIP code shared by multiple programs.
